title: check_role_bindings input
description: The direct assignment check. Confirms each product role is bound to an Entra group that exists, and flags any product role held outside a bound group, including by agent accounts, agent users or service principals. It also lists the Workload Grants (C42) and flags a direct assignment with no grant, an expired grant, and any grant to an agent identity. A read: it logs the check to an Audit Entry (O24) and changes nothing else.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12). Each pipeline or approval runner identity holds its workload role directly, recorded as a Workload Grant (C42). People get roles only through groups, and agent identities never get a grant.

includeDirectAssignments.description: True also lists every direct assignment found.
